name: Dmytro Serdun
headline: Flutter and Android apps, down to the operating system.
intro:
Mobile developer with 9 years in production apps: native Android since 2017, Flutter since 2019, and native Kotlin again since 2024 as the author of a call-handling plugin. Since 2022 I am the main contributor to a white-label VoIP softphone for iOS, Android and Web.

I work at the boundary between an app and the operating system: background and foreground services, process lifecycle, telephony, audio routing, push wake-ups. I also build the backend, build tooling and CI/CD around the apps I ship.

experience.summary: The same softphone product, now called PortaPhone, moved under PortaOne together with the call plugin and build tooling. Work continues on the same codebase.
White-label Flutter softphone for iOS, Android and Web. Public builds: WebTrit and PortaPhone 2 on Google Play and the App Store.
highlights: Main contributor since the start of the project, about 2.5k commits: calls over WebRTC (Janus), SIP presence, chat and SMS, voicemail, contact sync, call history, theming from remote config.

Author of the Android side of webtrit_callkeep (Kotlin, about 500 commits): Telecom ConnectionService in a separate process with foreground services, so a call survives backgrounding and process death.
Maintained the company forks of flutter-webrtc and janus-gateway: ICE over VPN, camera crash on concurrent video calls, SDP renegotiation and ICE restart stability.
CI/CD on GitHub Actions: configure a brand, build, sign and publish to Google Play and TestFlight.
Patrol end-to-end tests on real devices; the web configurator in Flutter Web with a NestJS backend on Cloud Run and PostgreSQL.

experience.summary: Native Android and Flutter apps for outsourcing clients, mostly startups building an MVP. Estimation, architecture, code review, releases.
highlights: Native Android (Java, Kotlin): Alias, Columbus Coffee Rewards, Arrkas, NightApp.
Flutter: mPet, Slaywoke, Daberli, a BLE companion app for measuring inhalation strength and other MVPs.

experience.summary: Foodie Family: food ordering and delivery with separate client and driver apps and live geolocation, published on Google Play.
